Rae (docs): Proposal: add a compact decision graphic on the error-ref page to show fallback order for 429s, timeouts, and context limits. People are confused about which fallback runs first.
Vik (eng-runtime): +1. Visual would help. Runtime order is client retry -> middleware trim/summarize -> model variant fallback -> regional failover. Streaming needs a separate note.
Maya (devex): I can draft a Mermaid block and include two tiny SDK snippets (JS + Python) for Retry-After handling. Keep snippets minimal.
Owen (eng-ml): Add a short note about KV cache when swapping to quantized variants; some quantized kernels change key layout. Recommend try-reuse then cold-start fallback.
Rae (docs): I'll open a PR with mermaid + prose + a short FAQ "When to retry vs trim?". Maya please add snippets, Vik please sanity-check triggers.
Maya (devex): Draft JS snippet in the PR will parse Retry-After and use decorrelated jitter. Python will be a small retry helper and mention circuit-breaker for persistent failures.
Vik (eng-runtime): I'll review and add a test that simulates repeated 429s to validate documented order. Also will add note on queue-depth thresholds for regional failover.
docs-bot: PR opened by Rae: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5250 :robot_face:
Rae (docs): Plan: merge after Maya's snippets and Vik review. Target: EOD Friday. Thanks all.
